description:
Make a new API key for your account. The secret is shown once, in this reply. Its id is in list_api_keys.
Use for: giving another agent or machine its own key, so you can revoke it alone later. At most 25 active keys.
Not for: finding the id of a key (list_api_keys); turning a key off (revoke_api_key).
Needs: an API key. Hosted sign-in cannot call this yet.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: create_api_key({"name":"Booking agent"})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: key_limit_reached, account_setup_required; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

name.description: A name to tell this key apart, 1 to 50 characters, not only spaces. Spaces around it are dropped.

name: create_api_key

prefix.description: The first 12 characters of the key, as list_api_keys shows it.

secret.description: The new key. Shown in this reply only: store it now. Send it in `X-API-Key`.

title: Create an API key
